newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 24.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 24.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:
* The low number of realised investment commitments were due to shortcomings of prospective investors, Investment Minister Sanyoto Sastrowardoyo said.

* The Dow ended down 94.28 points, or 1.38 percent, at 6,755.75 on Thursday on the largest trading volume ever, after a rapid sequence of sell programmes apparently triggered by a downdraft in the Standard & Poor's 500 index futures market.
* The Jakarta Composite Index fell 1.13 points, or 0.17 percent, to close at 684.98 points on Thursday after sustained profit taking in heavyweights such as Telkom and Gudang Garam.
* Bank BDNI which posted a net profit of 190.7 billion rupiah in 1996 against 140.2 billion rupiah in 1995.
* Lippo Securities on reports its 1996 net profit was likely to be better than expected.
* Bank BNI on market talk of a possible better-than-expected 1996 net profit.
* Telkom on reports it was studying the possibility of launching a cable television network.
* Transportation firm Centris on market talk that the firm was likely to acquire a transportation firm.
* Tapioca starch maker Budi Acid on reports it was in negotiations to set up two joint ventures with local and Japanese firms.
